ns2:course.label: Early 18th Century Literature
ns2:course.description: British Literature between 1600--the restoration of Charles II to the throne--and 1740. Focus on the plays, poems, and fiction by male and female authors with particular attention to issues of gender relations, colonialism and imperial expansion, and class tensions. Writers covered may include Aphra Behn, Alexander Pope, Eliza Haywood, Jonathan Swift, John Dryden, the Earl of Rochester, Daniel Defoe, and others. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college literature or consent of instructor.
